_about: Battle sound table for scripts/make_sfx.py. name = the take's name and the game's sound name (SfxSynth.Compose), game = the game's sound name when it differs (used by --install; the redo rows like crit_blade install as crit, and several picks for one game name go in as crit.wav, crit_2.wav ... in the order given, one played at random per hit), label = the row's words on the listening page (default: name), prompt = the sound itself and its materials, seconds = the length told to the model (the file is trimmed to where it has decayed), takes = how many seeds.

sounds.name: slash
sounds.prompt: A single sword blade swishing fast through the air, a sharp clean whoosh ending in a short crisp cut, one swing only.

sounds.name: hit
sounds.prompt: A single dull heavy thump of a fist striking padded leather armor, short and punchy, one impact only.

sounds.name: crit
sounds.prompt: A single powerful heavy impact, a deep thud with a bright metallic crack on top, strong and sharp, one blow only.

sounds.name: miss
sounds.prompt: A quick clear whoosh of a sword swung hard through empty air, close and airy, the swing passing by with no impact.

sounds.name: block
sounds.prompt: A steel sword striking a wooden shield with a metal rim, a solid knock followed by a short bright metallic ring, one hit only.

sounds.name: heal
sounds.prompt: A soft warm rising chime shimmer, gentle glass bells and a light sparkle swelling upward, then fading out.

sounds.name: coin
sounds.prompt: Two small gold coins clinking together once, a bright short metallic clink.

sounds.name: victory
sounds.prompt: A short bright triumphant fanfare of brass trumpets and a light drum, a rising three-note flourish ending on a held major chord.

sounds.name: crit_blade
sounds.label: crit: blade cut
sounds.prompt: A sharp sword blade cutting deep into its target, a fast bright steel slice ending in a hard tight smack, dry and close, one strike only.

sounds.name: crit_crack
sounds.label: crit: whip crack
sounds.prompt: A fierce heavy punch landing with a sharp snapping crack, a whip crack and a body blow at once, very short, dry and close, one hit only.

sounds.name: crit_ring
sounds.label: crit: steel ring
sounds.prompt: A sword striking steel plate armor at full force, a sharp bright clang with a short high ringing shing, crisp and piercing, one strike only.

sounds.name: victory_drums
sounds.label: victory: drums
sounds.prompt: A short roll on a deep timpani drum ending in one bright cymbal crash, bold and triumphant.

sounds.name: victory_chord
sounds.label: victory: big chord
sounds.prompt: One bright triumphant orchestral chord, brass and strings struck together once and ringing out, majestic and warm.

sounds.name: victory_lute
sounds.label: victory: lute
sounds.prompt: A quick happy flourish strummed on a lute with small bells, four rising notes ending on a bright chord, a medieval tavern cheer.

sounds.name: heal_glow
sounds.label: heal: glow
sounds.prompt: A soft warm hum swelling gently like a glowing light, ending in one clear small bell note, calm and soothing.

sounds.name: heal_harp
sounds.label: heal: harp
sounds.prompt: A soft harp glissando rising upward with a warm gentle glow, soothing and magical, short.
